definitions.explanation: Applicable to or affecting all people, places, or situations without exception. Describes values, truths, or phenomena that are not limited to a particular culture, era, or group.

examples.japanese: ⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{普遍的|ふへんてき}な⟦テーマ→テーマ：17684_teema⟧だ。
⟦{人権|じんけん}→人権：05416_jinken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{普遍的|ふへんてき}な⟦{価値|かち}→価値：00131_kachi⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: Human rights are a universal value.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えた→超える：01942_koeru⟧{普遍的|ふへんてき}な⟦{魅力|みりょく}→魅力：03749_miryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: This story has a universal appeal that transcends time.

notes:
{普遍的|ふへんてき} describes something that applies to or affects all people, places, or situations without exception.

FORMS:
{普遍|ふへん} (universality) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (adjectival suffix). The base noun {普遍|ふへん} also exists and means "universality."
- Na-adjective: {普遍的|ふへんてき}な⟦{価値|かち}→価値：00131_kachi⟧ (universal value)
- Adverbial: {普遍的|ふへんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}てはまる→当てはまる：10212_atehamaru⟧ (applies universally)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {普遍的|ふへんてき}な⟦{価値|かち}→価値：00131_kachi⟧: universal value
- {普遍的|ふへんてき}な⟦{真理|しんり}→真理：03333_shinri⟧: universal truth
- {普遍的|ふへんてき}な⟦テーマ→テーマ：17684_teema⟧: universal theme
- {普遍的|ふへんてき}な⟦{原理|げんり}→原理：00066_genri⟧: universal principle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧: general (less absolute than universal)
- ⟦{共通|きょうつう}→共通：02590_kyoutsuu⟧: common, shared (more everyday)
- {万国共通|ばんこくきょうつう}: common to all nations

REGISTER:
Formal/academic. Common in philosophy, law, and intellectual discourse. In casual speech, ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}てはまる→当てはまる：10212_atehamaru⟧ (applies to everyone) is more natural.
